title: Can't log in / password issues
content: 1) Reset password. 2) Check caps lock. 3) If account locked, wait 15 minutes. 4) If still failing, contact support with your email and a screenshot.

title: 502 Bad Gateway
content: Try again in 2 minutes. Check internet. If persistent, provide timestamp and screenshot; we will escalate to technical team.

title: App crashes on start
content: 1) Restart the app/device. 2) Update to latest version. 3) Clear cache. 4) Reinstall. 5) If still crashing, send device model + OS version + screenshot.
